capital.evidence_quote: Manama is the capital and largest city of Bahrain, a premier regional financial hub

currency.evidence_quote: The Bahraini Dinar (BHD) is pegged to the US Dollar at 1 BHD = 2.659 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Bahrain observes Arabia Standard Time UTC+3 year-round without daylight saving time

sources.title: Electricity and Water Authority of Bahrain (EWA)

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential single-phase electricity in Bahrain is delivered at 230V 50 Hz

sources.title: Electricity and Water Authority of Bahrain

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The electrical grid operating frequency in Bahrain is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets in Bahrain strictly adhere to the British three-rectangular-pin Type G standard

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for emergency police assistance throughout the Kingdom of Bahrain

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 999 for emergency medical assistance and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for emergency civil defence and fire rescue

general.evidence_quote: 112 functions as the secondary mobile emergency number alongside 999

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism security officers assist international visitors across Manama souqs and heritage sites

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Bahreyn genelinde güvenlik seviyesi çok yüksektir; standart seyahat tedbirleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Bahrain is one of the safest destinations in the Middle East; exercise normal precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Bahrain ist ein sehr sicheres Reiseland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: В Бахрейне высокий уровень безопасности; действуют обычные меры предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Baréin es un destino sumamente seguro; aplican precauciones normales de viaje.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Bahrain reach approximately 91.2 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Bahrain measure 96.5 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Batelco, stc Bahrain, and Zain offer 5G prepaid tourist eSIMs with airport counters open 24/7. BenefitPay is the universal mobile QR payment method used across all shops.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: 5G mobile connectivity covers the entire populated area of Bahrain

local_apps.description: Reliable, widely available ride-hailing services operating across Manama and Muharraq.

local_apps.description: Leading food and grocery delivery applications in Bahrain.

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları Bahreyn Uluslararası Havalimanı'nda Kapıda Vize (VoA - 14-30 gün) alabilir veya online e-Visa başvurusu yapabilir.

us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a 14-day or 30-day Visa on Arrival or apply online for a multi-entry eVisa.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens are eligible for Visa on Arrival at the port of entry or online eVisa.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can obtain a Visa on Arrival or apply for an eVisa prior to travel.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут получить визу по прибытии в аэропорту Бахрейна (14 дней с возможностью продления) или оформить eVisa.

dos.title: Respect Islamic cultural traditions
dos.description: Bahrain is cosmopolitan and open, but modest attire covering shoulders and knees is appreciated in malls and public areas.

dos.title: Visit the UNESCO Pearling Path
dos.description: Walk the historic architectural Pearling Path in Muharraq to learn about Bahrain's legendary pearl-diving heritage.

dos.title: Cross the King Fahd Causeway to Saudi Arabia if eligible
dos.description: The 25 km bridge connects Bahrain to Saudi Arabia; ensure you have a valid Saudi visa if crossing.

donts.title: Don't consume alcohol outside licensed venues
donts.description: Alcohol is permitted in licensed hotels and restaurants in Bahrain, but drinking in public streets is strictly forbidden.

donts.title: Don't eat or drink publicly during Ramadan daylight
donts.description: Consuming food, water, or smoking in public during Ramadan fasting hours is prohibited by law.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10-15% is customary in restaurants; rounding up taxi fares is appreciated.
